links.outcome: AF event detection performance across sex and age subgroups
links.effect: Performance was higher for female than male and higher for young adults (<61 years) than other age groups; attributed to higher atrial flutter prevalence in lower-performing groups. Overall generalized well.
links.quote: For the task of event detection ArNet2 performance was higher for female than male, higher for young adults (less than 61 years old) than other age groups and across geography.

links.outcome: AF detection performance across four geographic test centers
links.effect: Model generalized well across geography overall, with better performance on USA and China test sets than Israel and Japan; variation explained by atrial flutter prevalence.
links.quote: Finally, ArNet2 shows better performance for the test sets from the USA and China.

screen.reason: Evaluates a deep learning model for atrial fibrillation detection across diverse demographics and geographic distribution shifts (subgroup and equity evaluation across age, sex, and geography).
